text: Internal team already knows. Typography research this week focused on hierarchy. title: Pivot in Scope: Targeted Structural Fixes vs. Ground-Up Rebuild
text: Around the maroon accent so it reads as emphasis again instead of decoration. The hero was a specific focus. Right now, the primary visual real estate goes to a video embed. While the actual value proposition, who this is for and what to do next, competes for space in a narrow column. The direction being explored rebuilds the hero around what a firsttime visitor actually expects. A clear oneline answer to what the organization does, who it's for, and a single next step with supporting media playing a secondary role instead of the lead. This audit is also what changed the plan. The original scope was a full rebuild, but a full rebuild throws out everything that's already working. The mission clarity, the tone, the maroon and black identity along with everything that isn't. So, the direction shifted. Fix the structural problems first, navigation, hierarchy, hero, typography, and only revisit a groundup rebuild if targeted fixes aren't enough. Week one was the audit. Week two is the fix.
